project: Empty-Text Sentinel Chunks (Indexed Progress Without Per-Page Empties)
overview: Ensure documents with no extracted text can still reach folder state `indexed` without generating per-page empty chunks. Make `@orbital-poc/core` chunking semantically clean (empty text => zero chunks), and have ingest write a single doc-level sentinel chunk when needed to satisfy the `indexed` invariant.
goals: Folders with scanned/no-text documents can reach `indexed` (runnable) rather than staying permanently `ingesting`.
Avoid writing per-page empty chunks for empty-text documents or post-cap pages.
Keep chunking semantics in `@orbital-poc/core` reusable (no app-specific progress hacks).
Preserve deterministic/idempotent re-ingest behavior for chunks.
nonGoals: Implement OCR/layout-backed `line_window_v1` chunking or geometry-backed citations.
Change `ready` health checks or the extraction-quality heuristic/threshold.
Build an embedding job or change retrieval tuning/ranking.
successMetrics: Empty-text documents produce exactly one chunk row per (document_id, index_version) (a sentinel), not one per page.
Folders with empty-text documents can transition to `indexed` and enable Quick Start (while staying out of `ready` if quality gates fail).
functionalRequirements: FR-002: Chunking param validation throws for invalid params even when text is empty.
FR-003: For each (document_id, index_version), ingest writes either one or more real chunks, or exactly one sentinel chunk (empty text + sentinel metadata).
FR-004: Sentinel chunks are safe for retrieval: lexical queries do not match empty text, and semantic retrieval does not return sentinels because they are not embedded.
FR-005: Emit a structured log when a sentinel is written (no extracted text content).
FR-006: Persist `documents.metadata_json.extraction_total_chars` (total extracted chars across all pages); `0` means “no extracted text”.
FR-007: UI shows a “No text extracted” badge/message for documents where `documents.metadata_json.extraction_total_chars = 0`.

stories.title: Core chunker returns zero chunks for empty text (with validation)
stories.description: As an engineer, I want `char_window_v0` to treat empty text as producing no chunks (while still validating parameters) so downstream systems don't accumulate meaningless empty chunks and the core API stays semantically clean.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: `charWindowV0Spans("")` returns `[]` and `chunkPageCharWindowV0({ page_number: 1, text: "" })` returns `[]`.
Example: For non-empty text, chunking remains deterministic and overlapping windows match existing expectations.
Negative: `charWindowV0Spans("", { maxChars: 0, overlapChars: 0 })` throws an error matching /maxChars/.
Negative: `charWindowV0Spans("", { maxChars: 10, overlapChars: 10 })` throws an error matching /overlapChars/.

stories.title: Ingest writes a single doc-level sentinel chunk when a document has zero real chunks
stories.description: As the system, I want ingest to write exactly one sentinel chunk for a document+index_version when no real chunks exist, so folder state can reach `indexed` without creating per-page empty chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: When all extracted page text is empty for a document, ingest writes exactly 1 chunk row for (document_id, index_version) with `text=""` and sentinel metadata (e.g. `metadata_json.sentinel="no_extracted_text"`).
Example: When extracted page text is empty for a document, persist `documents.metadata_json.extraction_total_chars = 0` as an explicit document-level signal.
Example: Stale-tail deletion removes old real chunks when re-ingest now produces only the sentinel (chunk_index >= 1 deleted).
Negative: When any non-empty chunks are produced for a document+index_version, ingest writes no sentinel chunk.
Negative: Sentinel chunks are never written per page (no explosion proportional to page_count).

stories.title: Add regression tests for empty-text documents and indexed progression
stories.description: As an engineer, I want end-to-end tests proving empty-text docs do not flood chunks and still progress a folder to `indexed`, so the behavior stays stable as chunking/retrieval evolves.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Integration test mocks pdf.js extraction returning empty text for all pages and asserts `document_pages` count matches page_count and exactly 1 sentinel chunk exists for the doc+index_version.
Example: Derived folder state reaches `indexed` (and remains out of `ready` if extraction quality/health checks fail).
Negative: Retrieval does not return the sentinel chunk for a non-empty query (lexical branch should not match empty text; semantic branch requires embeddings).
Negative: Tests fail if more than 1 chunk is written for the empty-text document+index_version.

stories.title: UI shows a “No text extracted” badge/message for empty-text documents
stories.description: As an end user, I want an explicit, document-level indicator when extracted text is empty so I can understand why a doc may be low-quality or non-searchable even though the folder can reach `indexed`.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: In the matter/documents UI, documents with `documents.metadata_json.extraction_total_chars = 0` show a “No text extracted” badge/message.
Negative: Documents with `extraction_total_chars > 0` show no badge/message.
Negative: Documents without `extraction_total_chars` (older data) show no badge/message (avoid false positives).
Negative: The badge/message does not change folder state progression; it is informational only.

risks: Sentinel chunks could be embedded/retrieved later if an embedding/indexing pipeline does not filter empty text.
Some callers may interpret `indexed` as “high quality”; the intended distinction remains `ready` as the quality gate.
Chunk upsert may update content under a stable conflict target; downstream change detection must rely on `text_hash` if embeddings are introduced.
failureStatesAndUX: Empty-text documents are expected to remain `indexed` rather than `ready` due to health checks (quality gate).
True ingest/write failures continue to transition folder/doc state to `failed` with safe user-facing errors.
metricsLogging: Emit a structured log when writing a sentinel chunk (e.g. `ingest.no_extracted_text_sentinel_written`) with document_id, index_version, page_count, and total_chars.
verificationPlan: Unit tests: `packages/core/src/chunking/char_window_v0.test.ts` updated for empty-text semantics and validation.
Integration tests: `apps/web/test/ingestDocumentStepIdempotency.int.test.ts` includes an empty-text extraction case.
rollbackDisablePath: Rollback: revert the change and re-ingest (bump `folders.latest_index_version` / reload pack) to rebuild chunks.
Optional disable path (future): environment-controlled empty-text behavior mode (`doc_sentinel` vs `page_sentinel` vs `off`).
